authenticity_review: The image exhibits severe structural and semantic failures despite high pixel-level clarity. Physically, the stacking of semi-truck cabs directly on top of each other without support frames or carriers violates basic physics; the tires of the upper trucks appear to merge with the roofs of the lower ones (structural collapse artifact). Semantically, the prompt requested 'pickups' (light-duty trucks with open beds), but the image renders heavy-duty Class 8 tractor units. Similarly, the taxonomy specified a 'cock' (rooster), but the image shows a waterbird (pelican/heron). These fundamental mismatches in object class and physical plausibility severely degrade authenticity. The animal_pose_auditor's HIGH risk level (56% low-confidence keypoints) further supports structural anomalies in the bird rendering, though the primary authenticity penalty stems from the impossible truck stacking and wrong object classes.
key_defects: Spatial relationship failure: Bird is on top of trucks, not under them.
Object class mismatch: Heavy-duty semi-tractors rendered instead of light-duty pickups.
Object class mismatch: Waterbird rendered instead of rooster/cock.
Physical impossibility: Trucks stacked directly on cabs without support structures.
Counting error: 7 trucks visible (including partial) vs expected 6.
